{{Top|leg}}
[[Elikann Crater]] was one of many craters on [[Tasariq]], and was connected to [[Tasariq City]] and [[Barimoq Crater]] through an underground rapid-transit tube. The [[Imperial Ministry of Tourism]] listed it as one of the [[Wonders of the Galaxy/Legends|Wonders of the Galaxy]].
